population.oof_usage: none; outer OOF is not evaluated or used to choose aggregation

arms.name: gamma1_raw_cost_aware
arms.weight: exp(detached conservative log1p cost), clipped then normalized to mean one

actor_objective: mean(weight * conservative max(Q1,Q2) physical log1p Query J50)

gradient_contract.optimizer: raw full-fit gradient direction; no Adam state, momentum, weight decay, or Query analytic gradient
gradient_contract.speed_group_gradients: repeat the identical objective separately for 40/55/70/85/100 km/h and report pairwise parameter-gradient cosine

step_contract.calibration: deterministic bisection of one scalar parameter-step multiplier until full-fit Actor output RMS matches the registered target
step_contract.forcing_scope: diagnostic only; exact matching is not the later continuous-OAC cap-only training rule

routing.advance_gamma1: at the primary matched step, gamma1 has greater inner real-Query mean gain than gamma0 at both 85 and 100 km/h in at least two of three seeds, pooled mean is no worse, and pooled P05 worsens by no more than 0.25
routing.mixed_tail: if high-speed mean improves but the pooled P05 tolerance fails, test gamma0.5 before continuous OAC
routing.no_highspeed_gain: retain gamma0 and diagnose stable speed-group parameter-gradient conflict before changing Critic or collecting data

independent_validation: reload selected Actor/Twin Critics, reproduce all aggregate and speed gradients, reconstruct every matched-output Actor, and replay every inner Query cost
